name: Empower Personal Dashboard
description: Empower Personal Dashboard is a consumer financial dashboard for aggregated accounts, transactions, cash flow, budgets, net worth, investments, retirement planning, and financial guidance.
agentUseSummary: Empower Personal Dashboard cannot currently be connected as an autonomous Relay provider. Empower documents an interactive consumer account and Yodlee FastLink aggregation flow, but does not publish a Relay-usable member API, remote MCP endpoint, OAuth scopes, stable tool schemas, service credentials, or revocation contract. Its terms prohibit credential sharing, scraping, bots, reverse engineering, and automated account creation or financial-institution aggregation. Relay will not reuse sessions, capture credentials, or infer private endpoints.

blocked.label: Connect Empower through an unsupported session
blocked.description: Relay will not reuse an Empower browser session, capture Empower or financial-institution credentials or tokens, automate identity verification or consent, or reinterpret Yodlee aggregation as member API authority.

blocked.label: Access private Dashboard financial data
blocked.description: Accounts, balances, transactions, cash flow, income, spending, categories, budgets, assets, liabilities, net worth, investments, holdings, performance, retirement assumptions, goals, and advisory information are blocked without a supported least-privilege member API.

blocked.label: Change Dashboard records or plans
blocked.description: Creating, editing, deleting, categorizing, or annotating accounts, transactions, holdings, budgets, goals, retirement scenarios, manual assets, liabilities, and all other Dashboard records is blocked.

blocked.label: Link accounts or act on financial guidance
blocked.description: Adding, refreshing, reauthenticating, or removing financial institutions; changing aggregation credentials; opening investment products; contacting or authorizing advisers; and acting on tax, investment, debt, or retirement guidance are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported Dashboard automation
blocked.description: Dashboard scraping, bots, private endpoint discovery, UI automation, shared-credential use, raw session pass-through, reverse engineering, and automated account creation or aggregation are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Empower Personal Dashboard action can be enabled without a supported public member authorization and tool contract designed for third-party autonomous use.

runtimeSupport.description: Empower publishes no member-account API/MCP authorization or bounded tool contract that Relay can distribute as OpenClaw tools.
Empower publishes no member-account API/MCP authorization or bounded tool contract that Relay can distribute as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Empower Personal Dashboard is an interactive consumer financial service handling aggregated account credentials, balances, transactions, investments, net worth, planning assumptions, and advisory surfaces. Empower documents Yodlee FastLink aggregation but no public Relay-usable member API/MCP endpoint, stable schemas, scopes, service credentials, revocation lifecycle, or autonomous authorization boundary, and its terms explicitly prohibit automated extraction and account aggregation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Empower or institution credentials, reuse sessions, scrape the Dashboard, link accounts, or publish runtime tools. Reconsider only if Empower publishes a supported third-party member API or remote MCP contract with versioned schemas, least-privilege scopes, revocation, exact consumer/account binding, audit semantics, financial-data retention controls, and explicit confirmation for every write, account-linking, advisory, tax, investment, retirement, or product-opening action.

evidence.supports: Empower documents Personal Dashboard features for linked investments, cash, credit and other accounts, transactions, spending, net worth, budgets, retirement planning, debt, savings, tax-provider access, and professional financial guidance.
Empower documents an interactive identity-confirmation and credential-entry flow for linking retirement, mortgage, loan, banking, credit-card, and investment accounts into the Dashboard.

Empower states that Dashboard aggregation uses Yodlee FastLink and prohibits sharing credentials, reverse engineering, robots, spiders, crawlers, scraping, automated extraction, and automated account creation or financial-institution aggregation.
Empower documents private Dashboard account types, balances, transactions, assets, liabilities, and net-worth data inside its consumer web application rather than through a public third-party API.
